item.title: Core Scientific: $1 Billion Strategic Financing Facility Secured From Morgan Stanley To Expand Data Center Infrastructure
item.description: Core Scientific announced that it has completed the initial closing of a $500 million 364-day loan facility from Morgan Stanley, with the potential to expand the total commitments to up to $1 billion through an accordion feature. The financing strengthens the company’s liquidity as it continues to develop and scale its data center infrastructure. The agreement brings together Odine, which holds a 53% majority stake in Logate, with GTech to expand financial technology platforms and digital banking capabilities across Europe, the Balkans, Türkiye, the Middle East, and Africa.
